1.text: Bakundwa, uru ni rwo rwandiko rwa kabiri mbandikiye. Muri izo zombi imigambi yanjye yari iyo gukangura imitima yanyu itarimo uburiganya, mbibutsa

2.text: kugira ngo mwibuke amagambo yavuzwe kera n'abahanuzi bera, mwibuke n'itegeko ry'Umwami ari we Mukiza mwabwiwe n'intumwa zabatumweho.

3.text: Mubanze kumenya iki, yuko mu minsi y'imperuka hazaza abakobanyi bakobana, bakurikiza irari ryabo,

4.text: babaza bati “Isezerano ryo kuza kwe riri he? Ko uhereye aho ba sogokuruza basinziririye, byose bihora uko byahoze, uhereye ku kuremwa kw'isi.”

5.text: Nuko biyibagiza nkana yuko ijuru ryahozeho uhereye kera kose, n'isi yakuwe mu mazi ikazengurukwa na yo ku bw'ijambo ry'Imana,

6.text: ari byo byatumye isi ya kera irengwaho n'amazi ikarimbuka.

7.text: Ariko ijuru n'isi bya none, iryo jambo ni ryo na none ryabibikiye umuriro uzatera ku munsi w'amateka, urimbure abatubaha Imana.

8.text: Ariko bakundwa, iri jambo rimwe ntirikabasobe, yuko ku Mwami Imana umunsi umwe ari nk'imyaka igihumbi, n'imyaka igihumbi ari nk'umunsi umwe.

9.text: Umwami Imana ntitinza isezerano ryayo, nk'uko bamwe batekereza yuko iritinza. Ahubwo itwihanganira idashaka ko hagira n'umwe urimbuka, ahubwo ishaka ko bose bihana.

10.text: Ariko umunsi w'Umwami wacu uzaza nk'umujura, ubwo ijuru rizavaho hakaba n'umuriri ukomeye, maze iby'ishingiro, ibyo byose biremeshwa bikayengeshwa no gushya cyane, isi n'imirimo iyirimo bigashirīra.

11.text: Nuko ubwo ibyo byose bizayenga bityo, yemwe uko dukwiriye kuba abantu bera, kandi twubaha Imana mu ngeso zacu,

12.text: twebwe abategereza tugatebutsa umunsi w'Imana uzatuma ijuru rigurumana rikayenga, kandi iby'ishingiro, ibyo byose biremeshwa bigashongeshwa no gushya cyane!

13.text: Kandi nk'uko yasezeranije dutegereje ijuru rishya n'isi nshya, ibyo gukiranuka kuzabamo.

14.text: Ni cyo gituma bakundwa, ubwo mutegereje ibyo, mukwiriye kugira umwete wo kuzasangwa mu mahoro, mutagira ikizinga, mutariho umugayo mu maso ye.

15.text: Mumenye yuko kwihangana k'Umwami wacu ari agakiza, nk'uko mwene Data ukundwa Pawulo yabandikiye abwirijwe n'ubwenge yahawe,

16.text: ndetse no mu nzandiko ze zose yavuze ibyerekeye ibyo. Icyakora zirimo bimwe biruhije gusobanukirwa, ibyo abaswa bahindagurika bagoreka, nk'uko bagira ibyanditswe bindi bakizanira kurimbuka.

17.text: Nuko rero bakundwa, ubwo muburiwe hakiri kare, mwirinde mutayobywa n'uburiganya bw'abanyabyaha mukareka gushikama kwanyu.

18.text: Ahubwo mukurire mu buntu bw'Imana no kumenya Yesu Kristo Umwami wacu n'Umukiza. Icyubahiro kibe icye none n'iteka ryose. Amen.
